# hostd_ip_addresses (Data Source)

Public addresses on the account: dedicated servers, VPS and cloud projects, with the current PTR and whether it can be changed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hostd_ip_addresses" "account" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `addresses` (Attributes List) Addresses assigned to your services. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--addresses))

<a id="nestedatt--addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `addresses`

Read-Only:

- `can_release` (Boolean) Whether the address may be released to the pool.
- `can_update_ptr` (Boolean) Whether this key may change the PTR.
- `comment` (String) Comment stored with the address.
- `content` (String) PTR hostname.
- `ip` (String) Public IPv4 or IPv6 address.
- `service_kind` (String) `ds`, `vps` or `cloud`.
- `service_name` (String) Name of the service the address is attached to.
- `service_sid` (String) Service SID for dedicated servers and VPS.
- `service_uuid` (String) UUID of the dedicated server, VPS or cloud project.
- `status` (String) `attached` or `reserved`.
- `vm` (Attributes) Cloud VM the address is attached to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--addresses--vm))

<a id="nestedatt--addresses--vm"></a>
### Nested Schema for `addresses.vm`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) VM name.
- `vmid` (Number) VMID.
